The wedding was in Meron, he too was.., he too arrived in Meron

So he was.. joyous, and Rebbe Yisroel danced at the wedding on that Thursday night

{……} and his pants fell down, and he did not know, they approached him, stopped him {…...…}

[Yes, there were dances from the Upper World.. such dances f.., such a kind..]

Indeed

[From the Upper World]

Yes, his dances were such.. {whatever it is}

What I saw, I saw what was happening, but the world saw that his pants fell down

At any rate, my father-in-law.. he saw something {…}..

That one needs to go out to war, one needs to go out to war

“What does that mean? I will agree to his being a Breslover?”

Shoyn, good, Shabbos is the chuppah.., Friday was the chuppah, Shabbos, what can he {.…}

After the wedding, Sunday we travel home, {….} the second Shabbos arrives..

The second Shabbos, then {..} my father-in-law, I ate at his place on Friday night, “I ate mezonos at his place”

After the food, he takes the key, he locks the door, and..

“Here you will sit, here you will sit, from here you are not going out, on Friday night you are not going to Rebbe Yisroel” the point is, I say to myself: “What is this called, they lock a person in with a key? {What is this?}” Nu, go shout: “Alive and enduring”

He locked {….}, and I was, and I was in confinement, unable to go to Rebbe Yisroel

When it became midnight.. {….} midnight, midnight they go to sleep

“Midnight, Rebbe Yisroel is already asleep, he is asleep, it is possible to open”

{….}, then he went, opened the door

The room for me was.., he rented me a room

“I ate mezonos at his place,” he gave me a room to sleep in, a small room

segments.en:
And my room, when I needed to go, when I needed to go out to the street

There was a way, a way, through him, through his house

From his house {…}, even though he was sure that this late one does not go

He sat and watched, sat at the window, sat at the window and.. and watched, {…..}

He sat at the window, and I went, and I went, h.. he saw that I was going, so he went:

“Gevald, oy.. so late at night and h.., and he is going?”

So he went down and.. and.. and chased after me to catch me, to bring me back

But I ran ahead of him, I ran faster than he did

And I reached Rebbe Yisroel (Kardonner) and told him the story, that he locked and.. and.. and.. and..

I told, I told everything, I told the story, and said that he, ah.. ah.. he will find me here in {….} he will break everything in the house, he will hit, he.. he..

{….}, already I, I am going back

He ran, and I ran from Rebbe Yisroel (Kardonner), we had already seen each other, I ran back

So the way, there was a way from Rebbe Yisroel (Kardonner) to him, one had to pass by the shops that sell meat

And in the previous years they did not sell the bones, the bones they would throw on.., on the street, and the dogs of the city, all the dogs knew there, there {….}

There it is {“the bone factory”}

Nu, I passed there, all the dogs of Tzfas stood and ate the bones

He.. he.. he could not catch me

And there among the dogs, there he caught me, he knocked me down onto the dogs

{..}, he {…} hit

And.. and reached home.. such a kind, such a kind, like this, like this

And the order? What is this called? {What..}…
